en.t: It was the second floor of a bookstore.

units.source_text: 刚满二十岁的他踏上靠在书架上的西式梯子，寻找新书。

en.t: Having just turned twenty, he stepped onto a Western-style ladder leaning against the bookshelves and looked for new books.

units.source_text: 莫泊桑、波德莱尔 、斯特林堡、易卜生、萧伯纳、托尔斯泰……

en.t: Maupassant, Baudelaire, Strindberg, Ibsen, Shaw, Tolstoy...
